notes: The macOS 27 SDK adds the ByteOrder enum and RawSpan.load(fromByteOffset:as:_:) for fixed-width integers, both @available(anyAppleOS 27.0, *). At a macOS 26.0 deployment target the overload needs #available; the fallback loads with unsafeLoadUnaligned(fromByteOffset:as:) and converts with UInt32(bigEndian:).
